github_schema.U10_sustained_ms: 10 m height, 10-min mean wind speed [m/s]; conversions: /1.14 from 1-min, /1.06 from 2-min (CMA), /1.05 from 3-min (IMD), /1.42 from 3-s gust (Durst, open exposure)
github_schema.Iu: assumed longitudinal turbulence intensity at 10 m for spectral buffeting (open water 0.10-0.12, land 0.15-0.20, convective 0.20-0.25, tornado 0.25 nominal)
github_schema.confidence: A = value verified online this session with source; B = authoritative scale/code anchor cited by name; C = literature-level number, not re-verified online this session
github_schema.usage: non-stationary small-scale events (tornado/downburst) only give order-of-magnitude reference under stationary spectral buffeting

github_site_defaults.site: Zhangjinggao Yangtze bridge, south channel (main span 2300 m, towers 350 m, catwalk erection from 2026-09)
github_site_defaults.site_anchor: Sutong bridge site study: 100-yr 10-min basic design wind 38.9 m/s (same reach, 16 km from Husutong bridge)

derived_controls.minimum_frequency_policy: GitHub 5e-4 Hz lower integration point is raised to 1/600 Hz for a 600 s periodic record
derived_controls.sigma_u_definition: sigma_u=Iu*U10; U_deck is used for profile-dependent mean wind and coherence, not turbulence standard deviation
derived_controls.provenance_note: seed/duration/dt are I08 future CCX mapping controls, not parameters of the GitHub spectral sweep
